shell.title: Project Builder
shell.subtitle: From idea to Milestone-1 backlog
shell.emptyHint: One or two sentences are enough — the Builder will interview you briefly and propose a full blueprint. You can also ask it to decide everything for you.
shell.createSpecsHint: Available once the blueprint has Milestone-1 specs

panel.title: Blueprint
panel.empty: The blueprint fills in as you talk.

commit.title: Create the project
commit.description: Nothing touches disk until you confirm. The repo stays pristine — Specrails artifacts live outside it.
commit.locationHint: A new folder will be created here (must be empty or absent).
commit.githubAuthHint: Sign in first: gh auth login

errors.generic: The commit could not start. Check the values and try again.
errors.unknown_provider: One of the selected providers is not available.
errors.invalid_blueprint: The blueprint is incomplete — go back and finish it with the Builder.
errors.m1_specs_required: The blueprint has no Milestone-1 specs yet.
errors.m1_specs_over_cap: Milestone 1 has too many specs (max 10). Ask the Builder to slim it down.
errors.m1_spec_quality_invalid: The generated specs are not implementation-ready yet. Return to the Builder and refine the indicated item.
errors.bundled_framework_missing: The bundled framework is missing — reinstall the Specrails app.
errors.location_not_empty: That folder already exists and is not empty. Pick another location.
errors.location_already_registered: That location already belongs to a registered project.
errors.commit_failed: The project creation failed — see the step list for the reason.

githubErrors.gh_not_installed: GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed — repository not created
githubErrors.gh_not_authenticated: gh is not signed in (run gh auth login) — repository not created
githubErrors.gh_scope: Your gh token cannot create repositories (missing repo scope)
githubErrors.gh_repo_exists: A repository with that name already exists on your account
githubErrors.gh_network: Network error talking to GitHub — repository not created

done.title: Project created
done.description: Your Milestone-1 backlog is on the board, labeled M1.
done.launchToast: Milestone 1 launched — {{count}} specs on one rail

sidebar.title: Blueprint
sidebar.generateHint: Opens a grounded spec session seeded with the blueprint

errors.startFailed: Could not start the Builder conversation.

milestone.title: Generate {{label}}
milestone.commitToast: {{count}} specs committed to the board as {{label}}

mode.title: Project Builder
mode.subtitle: The agent is building a new project
mode.exitConfirmBody: The blueprint in progress will be discarded.

prompts.surpriseMe: Surprise me — propose sensible defaults for every blueprint dimension, keep m1Specs empty, and let me approve the plan before generating detailed specs.
prompts.milestoneSeed: Generate the detailed specs for milestone {{label}} ("{{title}}"). Read the real codebase first, validate the complete batch, then emit ALL detailed milestone specs in one blueprint-draft response/snapshot.
prompts.milestoneSeedWithPlanned: Generate the detailed specs for milestone {{label}} ("{{title}}"). Planned spec titles: {{planned}}. Read the real codebase first, validate the complete batch, then emit ALL detailed milestone specs in one blueprint-draft response/snapshot.
